title: rosa villosa var. cinerascens
intro: Rosa villosa var. cinerascens, commonly known as Sweetbriar or Eglantine, is a thorny, deciduous shrub native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa villosa var. cinerascens include acting as a diuretic, expectorant, and antiseptic, making it useful for treating respiratory issues, urinary problems, and skin infections. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
